name: BrightEdge Autopilot Page Publisher
description: Update Title, Meta Description and H1 tag (and arbitrary XPath-targeted elements) from BrightEdge Autopilot recommendations, applied via REST endpoints and a response-rewrite subscriber.
project_description:
Introduction 
 The BrightEdge Autopilot Page Publisher is a comprehensive Drupal module that seamlessly integrates with the BrightEdge SEO platform to enable automated content optimisation and SEO management. This module provides a powerful bridge between your Drupal content management system and BrightEdge's advanced SEO recommendations, allowing for real-time updates of page titles, meta descriptions, H1 tags, and other critical SEO elements through both manual interface, BrightEdge Platform and BrightEdge Chrome Extension as well.

 The module enhances your content editing experience with live Google SERP previews and provides a secure bridge to update content meta information via BrightEdge Platform and Chrome extension, making it an essential tool for SEO professionals and content managers who want to leverage BrightEdge's AI-powered SEO recommendations directly within their Drupal workflow.

 Features 
 

 Core SEO Management: Live Google SERP preview inside content forms; integrated meta title / meta description editing on any entity with a metatag field; H1 tag optimization; XPath element targeting for precise element updates.

 Advanced Features: BrightEdge Chrome Extension and the BrightEdge Platform push changes through POST REST endpoints (update-meta, read-meta, update-xpath), authenticated with a Drupal username/password that holds the 'administer nodes' permission.

 Post Installation: configure content editors with permission to edit content types that carry metatag fields, then submit a Drupal user's credentials to the BrightEdge platform for API access and test the integration by editing content.

 Dependencies: Metatag (meta tag field), Node (content entity support), Token. Compatible with Drupal 8, 9, 10 and 11.

 This module is developed and maintained by BrightEdge Technologies.
